methods: The town own item P131 names this municipio; its original point is inside that exact municipio geometry in the same province. Set null parent_id and level 3; preserve town type and all other fields.

The retained own municipio item or independently matched GeoNames ADM2 row and ONEI province/name identify the same existing territorial row; type, local type and level only. Existing name, point, ID, population, item and ancestry are unchanged.

The unchanged Pinar del Río point/name and matched PPLA2 source row identify the seat town. Q555956 has P131 Santiago de Cuba Province; Q1817531 belongs to the separately represented Pinar municipio. Clear the copied wrong item; do not assign the municipio item to the town.

ONEI table 2.7.1 municipio/province with conventional Spanish name from its own matching Wikidata Spanish label, else ONEI with standard accents and capitalisation; names.csv records the decision; no existing municipio row in the reviewed inventory; own Wikidata municipality item and a unique literal Earth P625, unchanged except decimal formatting, strictly inside its own geoBoundaries ADM2 geometry. No population is copied. Latin own labels else ONEI name; pt independent of pt-br; non-Latin own labels only, Chinese simplified with ICU Hans. Multiple or unavailable points and uncertain scopes held.
